descriptions.title: Summon Boat
descriptions.text: Summons an existing, friendly, unoccupied boat from anywhere in the world to your location.  Chances for success are 50%.

descriptions.title: Basic Summon Boat
descriptions.text: Summons an existing, friendly, unoccupied boat from anywhere in the world to your location.  Chances for success are 50%.

descriptions.title: Advanced Summon Boat
descriptions.text: Summons an existing, friendly, unoccupied boat from anywhere in the world to your location.  If no boats exist, one is created.  Chances for success are 75%.

descriptions.title: Expert Summon Boat
descriptions.text: Summons an existing, friendly, unoccupied boat from anywhere in the world to your location.  If no boats exist, one is created.

descriptions.title: Scuttle Boat
descriptions.text: Destroys a boat you own.  Use with caution, the effects are permanent.  Chances for success are 50%.

descriptions.title: Basic Scuttle Boat
descriptions.text: Destroys a boat you own.  Use with caution, the effects are permanent.  Chances for success are 50%.

descriptions.title: Advanced Scuttle Boat
descriptions.text: Destroys a boat you own.  Use with caution, the effects are permanent.  Chances for success are 75%.

descriptions.title: Expert Scuttle Boat
descriptions.text: Destroys a boat you own.  Use with caution, the effects are permanent.

descriptions.title: Visions
descriptions.text: Gives you a basic idea of the strength of an opposing army, hero, or garrison.

descriptions.title: Basic Visions
descriptions.text: Gives you a basic idea of the strength of an opposing hero or garrison.  In the case of nearby wandering monsters, gives you exact numbers of troops and tells you if they would be willing to join your hero.

descriptions.title: Advanced Visions
descriptions.text: Gives you a basic idea of the strength of an opposing garrison.  In the case of nearby wandering monsters, gives you exact numbers of troops and tells you if they would be willing to join your hero.  Allows you to view a nearby enemy hero's primary skill statistics, creature type and quantity, as if the hero was part of your kingdom.

descriptions.title: Expert Visions
descriptions.text: Gives you exact numbers of wandering monsters and tells you if they would be willing to join your hero.  Allows you to view a nearby enemy hero's primary skill statistics, creature type and quantity, as if the hero was part of your kingdom, as well as a nearby town's statistics, garrison creatures and quantity.

descriptions.title: View earth
descriptions.text: Reveals the location of all resources to the caster.

descriptions.title: Basic View Earth
descriptions.text: Reveals the location of all resources to the caster.

descriptions.title: Advanced View Earth
descriptions.text: Reveals the location of all resources and mines to the caster.

descriptions.title: Expert View Earth
descriptions.text: Reveals the location of all resources and mines and reveals all terrain to the caster.

descriptions.title: Disguise
descriptions.text: Gives false information to an enemy attempting to view your hero.

descriptions.title: Basic Disguise
descriptions.text: Makes all units in your army look like your most powerful unit to enemies trying to view your hero.  Numbers in each group are unchanged.

descriptions.title: Advanced Disguise
descriptions.text: Makes all units in your army look like your most powerful unit to enemies trying to view your hero.  Numbers in each group appear as zero.

descriptions.title: Expert Disguise
descriptions.text: Makes all units in your army look like the most powerful unit affiliated to your hero type to enemies trying to view your hero.  Numbers in each group appear as zero.

descriptions.title: View Air
descriptions.text: Reveals the location of all unclaimed artifacts to the caster.

descriptions.title: Basic View Air
descriptions.text: Reveals the location of all unclaimed artifacts to the caster.

descriptions.title: Advanced View Air
descriptions.text: Reveals the location of all unclaimed artifacts, plus enemy heroes to the caster.

descriptions.title: Expert View Air
descriptions.text: Reveals the location of all unclaimed artifacts, plus enemy heroes and towns to the caster.

descriptions.title: Fly
descriptions.text: Allows your army to use part of its movement to fly over obstacles.  You must land at the end of the turn.

descriptions.title: Basic Fly
descriptions.text: Allows your army to use part of its movement to fly over obstacles.  You must land at the end of the turn.

descriptions.title: Advanced Fly
descriptions.text: Allows your army to use most of its movement to fly over obstacles.  You must land at the end of the turn.

descriptions.title: Expert Fly
descriptions.text: Allows your army to use up to all of its movement to fly over obstacles.  You must land at the end of the turn.

descriptions.title: Water Walk
descriptions.text: Allows your army to use part of its movement to walk across bodies of water.  You must end your movement on dry land.

descriptions.title: Basic Water Walk
descriptions.text: Allows your army to use part of its movement to walk across bodies of water.  You must end your movement on dry land.

descriptions.title: Advanced Water Walk
descriptions.text: Allows your army to use most of its movement to walk across bodies of water.  You must end your movement on dry land.

descriptions.title: Expert Water Walk
descriptions.text: Allows your army to use up to all of its movement to walk across bodies of water.  You must end your movement on dry land.

descriptions.title: Dimension Door
descriptions.text: Once per day, you may teleport your hero to a visible, unoccupied location on the adventure map.

descriptions.title: Basic Dimension Door
descriptions.text: Twice per day, you may teleport your hero to a visible, unoccupied location on the adventure map.

descriptions.title: Advanced Dimension Door
descriptions.text: Three times per day, you may teleport your hero to a visible, unoccupied location on the adventure map.

descriptions.title: Expert Dimension Door
descriptions.text: Four times per day, you may teleport your hero to a visible, unoccupied location on the adventure map.

descriptions.title: Town Portal
descriptions.text: Teleports your hero to the nearest friendly town.  The town must be unoccupied.

descriptions.title: Basic Town Portal
descriptions.text: Teleports your hero to the nearest friendly town.  The town must be unoccupied.

descriptions.title: Advanced Town Portal
descriptions.text: Teleports your hero to any friendly town.  The town must be unoccupied.

descriptions.title: Expert Town Portal
descriptions.text: Teleports your hero to any friendly town.  The town must be unoccupied.

descriptions.title: Quicksand
descriptions.text: Randomly places four small patches of quicksand on the battlefield which are only visible to the caster and creatures native to the terrain.  Walking into quicksand ends a unit's movement for the turn and makes it visible to all.

descriptions.title: Basic Quicksand
descriptions.text: Randomly places four small patches of quicksand on the battlefield which are only visible to the caster and creatures native to the terrain.  Walking into quicksand ends a unit's movement for the turn and makes it visible to all.

descriptions.title: Advanced Quicksand
descriptions.text: Randomly places six small patches of quicksand on the battlefield which are only visible to the caster and creatures native to the terrain.  Walking into quicksand ends a unit's movement for the turn and makes it visible to all.

descriptions.title: Expert Quicksand
descriptions.text: Randomly places eight small patches of quicksand on the battlefield which are only visible to the caster and creatures native to the terrain.  Walking into quicksand ends a unit's movement for the turn and makes it visible to all.

descriptions.title: Land Mine
descriptions.text: Randomly places four small areas of landmines on the battlefield which are only visible to the caster and creatures native to the terrain.  It inflicts damage to any unit walking over it.

descriptions.title: Basic Land Mine
descriptions.text: Randomly places four small areas of landmines on the battlefield which are only visible to the caster and creatures native to the terrain.  It inflicts damage to any unit walking over it.

descriptions.title: Advanced Land Mine
descriptions.text: Randomly places six small areas of landmines on the battlefield which are only visible to the caster and creatures native to the terrain.  It inflicts damage to any unit walking over it.  Inflicted damage 25 points more than Basic Land Mine.

descriptions.title: Expert Land Mine
descriptions.text: Randomly places eight small areas of landmines on the battlefield which are only visible to the caster and creatures native to the terrain.  It inflicts damage to any unit walking over it.  Inflicted damage 75 points more than Basic Land Mine.

descriptions.title: Force Field
descriptions.text: Places a small Force Field on the battlefield at a point specified by the caster.

descriptions.title: Basic Force Field
descriptions.text: Places a small Force Field on the battlefield at a point specified by the caster.

descriptions.title: Advanced Force Field
descriptions.text: Places a medium sized Force Field on the battlefield at a point specified by the caster.

descriptions.title: Expert Force Field
descriptions.text: Places a medium sized Force Field on the battlefield at a point specified by the caster.

descriptions.title: Fire Wall
descriptions.text: Places a small wildfire on the battlefield at a point specified by the caster.  Any units passing through the wall take damage.

descriptions.title: Basic Fire Wall
descriptions.text: Places a small wildfire on the battlefield at a point specified by the caster.  Any units passing through the wall take damage.

descriptions.title: Advanced Fire Wall
descriptions.text: Places a medium sized wildfire on the battlefield at a point specified by the caster.  Any units passing through the wall take damage.

descriptions.title: Expert Fire Wall
descriptions.text: Places a medium sized wildfire on the battlefield at a point specified by the caster.  Any units passing through the wall take damage.

descriptions.title: Earthquake
descriptions.text: Randomly damages two sections of castle wall in combat.

descriptions.title: Basic Earthquake
descriptions.text: Randomly damages two sections of castle wall in combat.

descriptions.title: Advanced Earthquake
descriptions.text: Randomly damages three sections of castle wall in combat.

descriptions.title: Expert Earthquake
descriptions.text: Randomly damages four sections of castle wall in combat.

descriptions.title: Magic Arrow
descriptions.text: Causes a bolt of magical energy to strike the selected unit.

descriptions.title: Basic Magic Arrow
descriptions.text: Causes a bolt of magical energy to strike the selected unit.

descriptions.title: Advanced Magic Arrow
descriptions.text: Causes a bolt of magical energy to strike the selected unit.  Damage inflicted is 10 points more than Basic Magic Arrow.

descriptions.title: Expert Magic Arrow
descriptions.text: Causes a bolt of magical energy to strike the selected unit.  Damage inflicted is 20 points more than Basic Magic Arrow.

descriptions.title: Ice Bolt
descriptions.text: Drains the body heat from the selected enemy unit.

descriptions.title: Basic Ice Bolt
descriptions.text: Drains the body heat from the selected enemy unit.

descriptions.title: Advanced Ice Bolt
descriptions.text: Drains the body heat from the selected enemy unit.  Damage inflicted is 10 points more than Basic Ice Bolt.

descriptions.title: Expert Ice Bolt
descriptions.text: Drains the body heat from the selected enemy unit.  Damage inflicted is 40 points more than Basic Ice Bolt.

descriptions.title: Lightning Bolt
descriptions.text: Causes a bolt of lightning to strike the selected unit.

descriptions.title: Basic Lightning Bolt
descriptions.text: Causes a bolt of lightning to strike the selected unit.

descriptions.title: Advanced Lightning Bolt
descriptions.text: Causes a bolt of lightning to strike the selected unit.  Damage inflicted is 10 points more than Basic Lightning Bolt.

descriptions.title: Expert Lightning Bolt
descriptions.text: Causes a bolt of lightning to strike the selected unit.  Damage inflicted is 40 points more than Basic Lightning Bolt.

descriptions.title: Implosion
descriptions.text: Inflicts massive damage to a single creature stack.

descriptions.title: Basic Implosion
descriptions.text: Inflicts massive damage to a single creature stack.

descriptions.title: Advanced Implosion
descriptions.text: Inflicts massive damage to a single creature stack.  Damage inflicted is 100 points more than Basic Implosion.

descriptions.title: Expert Implosion
descriptions.text: Inflicts massive damage to a single creature stack.  Damage inflicted 200 points more than Basic Implosion.

descriptions.title: Chain Lightning
descriptions.text: Fires a bolt of lightning at the selected unit which then travels to the nearest adjacent unit, inflicting half damage before traveling to the next adjacent unit, again inflicting half damage, etc.  Strikes four units.

descriptions.title: Basic Chain Lightning
descriptions.text: Fires a bolt of lightning at the selected unit which then travels to the nearest adjacent unit, inflicting half damage before traveling to the next adjacent unit, again inflicting half damage, etc.  Strikes four units.

descriptions.title: Advanced Chain Lightning
descriptions.text: Fires a bolt of lightning at the selected unit which then travels to the nearest adjacent unit, inflicting half damage before traveling to the next adjacent unit, again inflicting half damage, etc.  Strikes five units.  Base Damage inflicted is 25 points more than Basic Chain Lightning.

descriptions.title: Expert Chain Lightning
descriptions.text: Fires a bolt of lightning at the selected unit which then travels to the nearest adjacent unit, inflicting half damage before traveling to the next adjacent unit, again inflicting half damage, etc.  Strikes five units.  Base Damage inflicted is 75 points more than Basic Chain Lightning.

descriptions.title: Frost Ring
descriptions.text: Drains the body heat of any units adjacent to the target location, without inflicting damage on the target.

descriptions.title: Basic Frost Ring
descriptions.text: Drains the body heat of any units adjacent to the target location, without inflicting damage on the target.

descriptions.title: Advanced Frost Ring
descriptions.text: Drains the body heat of any units adjacent to the target location, without inflicting damage on the target.  Damage inflicted is 15 points more than Basic Frost Ring.

descriptions.title: Expert Frost Ring
descriptions.text: Drains the body heat of any units adjacent to the target location, without inflicting damage on the target.  Damage inflicted is 45 points more than Basic Frost Ring.

descriptions.title: Fireball
descriptions.text: Causes the selected target to burst into flames, inflicting fire damage to the target and any adjacent units.

descriptions.title: Basic Fireball
descriptions.text: Causes the selected target to burst into flames, inflicting fire damage to the target and any adjacent units.

descriptions.title: Advanced Fireball
descriptions.text: Causes the selected target to burst into flames, inflicting fire damage to the target and any adjacent units.  Damage inflicted is 15 points more than Basic Fireball.

descriptions.title: Expert Fireball
descriptions.text: Causes the selected target to burst into flames, inflicting fire damage to the target and any adjacent units.  Damage inflicted is 45 points more than Basic Fireball.

descriptions.title: Inferno
descriptions.text: Causes a huge blast of fire to strike the selected target.  Don't be near this when it goes off!

descriptions.title: Basic Inferno
descriptions.text: Causes a huge blast of fire to strike the selected target.  Don't be near this when it goes off!

descriptions.title: Advanced Inferno
descriptions.text: Causes a huge blast of fire to strike the selected target.  Don't be near this when it goes off!  Damage inflicted is 20 points more than Basic Inferno.

descriptions.title: Expert Inferno
descriptions.text: Causes a huge blast of fire to strike the selected target.  Don't be near this when it goes off!  Damage inflicted is 60 points more than Basic Inferno.

descriptions.title: Meteor Shower
descriptions.text: Causes a meteor shower to rain down on the selected target and any adjacent units.

descriptions.title: Basic Meteor Shower
descriptions.text: Causes a meteor shower to rain down on the selected target and any adjacent units.

descriptions.title: Advanced Meteor Shower
descriptions.text: Causes a meteor shower to rain down on the selected target and any adjacent units.  Damage inflicted is 25 points more than Basic Meteor Shower.

descriptions.title: Expert Meteor Shower
descriptions.text: Causes a meteor shower to rain down on the selected target and any adjacent units.  Damage inflicted is 75 points more than Basic Meteor Shower.

descriptions.title: Death Ripple
descriptions.text: Sends a wave of death across the battlefield which damages all non-undead units.

descriptions.title: Basic Death Ripple
descriptions.text: Sends a wave of death across the battlefield which damages all non-undead units.

descriptions.title: Advanced Death Ripple
descriptions.text: Sends a wave of death across the battlefield which damages all non-undead units.  Damage inflicted is 10 points more than Basic Death Ripple.

descriptions.title: Expert Death Ripple
descriptions.text: Sends a wave of death across the battlefield which damages all non-undead units.  Damage inflicted is 20 points more than Basic Death Ripple.

descriptions.title: Destroy Undead
descriptions.text: Attempts to destroy any undead creatures on the battlefield.

descriptions.title: Basic Destroy Undead
descriptions.text: Attempts to destroy any undead creatures on the battlefield.

descriptions.title: Advanced Destroy Undead
descriptions.text: Attempts to destroy any undead creatures on the battlefield.  Damage inflicted is 10 points more than Basic Destroy Undead.

descriptions.title: Expert Destroy Undead
descriptions.text: Attempts to destroy any undead creatures on the battlefield.  Damage inflicted is 40 points more than Basic Destroy Undead.

descriptions.title: Armageddon
descriptions.text: Rains fire down upon the battlefield, damaging all units.

descriptions.title: Basic Armageddon
descriptions.text: Rains fire down upon the battlefield, damaging all units.

descriptions.title: Advanced Armageddon
descriptions.text: Rains fire down upon the battlefield, damaging all units.  Damage inflicted is 30 points more than Basic Armageddon.

descriptions.title: Expert Armageddon
descriptions.text: Rains fire down upon the battlefield, damaging all units.  Damage inflicted is 90 points more than Basic Armageddon.

descriptions.title: Shield
descriptions.text: Shields a selected unit, reducing the amount of damage received from hand-to-hand attacks.

descriptions.title: Basic Shield
descriptions.text: Shields a selected unit, reducing the amount of damage received from hand-to-hand attacks.

descriptions.title: Advanced Shield
descriptions.text: Shields a selected unit, reducing the amount of damage received from hand-to-hand attacks.  Protection is twice that of Basic Shield.

descriptions.title: Expert Shield
descriptions.text: Shields all friendly units, reducing the amount of damage received from hand-to-hand attacks.  Protection is twice that of Basic Shield.

descriptions.title: Air Shield
descriptions.text: Shields a selected unit, reducing the amount of damage received from ranged attacks.

descriptions.title: Basic Air Shield
descriptions.text: Shields a selected unit, reducing the amount of damage received from ranged attacks.

descriptions.title: Advanced Air Shield
descriptions.text: Shields a selected unit, reducing the amount of damage received from ranged attacks.  Protection is twice that of Basic Air Shield.

descriptions.title: Expert Air Shield
descriptions.text: Shields all friendly units, reducing the amount of damage received from ranged attacks.  Protection is twice that of Basic Air Shield.

descriptions.title: Fire Shield
descriptions.text: Cast on a friendly unit, it does not provide any additional protection, but any enemy attacking through the fire shield will suffer damage equal to a portion of what it inflicts.

descriptions.title: Basic Fire Shield
descriptions.text: Cast on a friendly unit, it does not provide any additional protection, but any enemy attacking through the fire shield will suffer damage equal to a portion of what it inflicts.

descriptions.title: Advanced Fire Shield
descriptions.text: Cast on a friendly unit, it does not provide any additional protection, but any enemy attacking through the fire shield will suffer damage equal to a portion of what it inflicts.  Damage to attacking enemy units is 5% more than Basic Fire Shield.

descriptions.title: Expert Fire Shield
descriptions.text: Cast on a friendly unit, it does not provide any additional protection, but any enemy attacking through the fire shield will suffer damage equal to a portion of what it inflicts.  Damage to attacking enemy units is 10% more than Basic Fire Shield.

descriptions.title: Protection from Air
descriptions.text: Protects the selected unit, reducing damage received from Air spells.

descriptions.title: Basic Protection from Air
descriptions.text: Protects the selected unit, reducing damage received from Air spells.

descriptions.title: Advanced Protection from Air
descriptions.text: Protects the selected unit, reducing damage received from Air spells.  Protection is nearly twice that of Basic Protection from Air.

descriptions.title: Expert Protection from Air
descriptions.text: Protects the selected unit, reducing damage received from Air spells.  Protection is nearly twice that of Basic Protection from Air.

descriptions.title: Protection from Fire
descriptions.text: Protects the selected unit, reducing damage received from Fire spells.

descriptions.title: Basic Protection from Fire
descriptions.text: Protects the selected unit, reducing damage received from Fire spells.

descriptions.title: Advanced Protection from Fire
descriptions.text: Protects the selected unit, reducing damage received from Fire spells.  Protection is nearly twice that of Basic Protection from Fire.

descriptions.title: Expert Protection from Fire
descriptions.text: Protects the selected unit, reducing damage received from Fire spells.  Protection is nearly twice that of Basic Protection from Fire.

descriptions.title: Protection from Water
descriptions.text: Protects the selected unit, reducing damage received from Water spells.

descriptions.title: Basic Protection from Water
descriptions.text: Protects the selected unit, reducing damage received from Water spells.

descriptions.title: Advanced Protection from Water
descriptions.text: Protects the selected unit, reducing damage received from Water spells.  Protection is nearly twice that of Basic Protection from Water.

descriptions.title: Expert Protection from Water
descriptions.text: Protects the selected unit, reducing damage received from Water spells.  Protection is nearly twice that of Basic Protection from Water.

descriptions.title: Protection from Earth
descriptions.text: Protects the selected unit, reducing damage received from Earth spells.

descriptions.title: Basic Protection from Earth
descriptions.text: Protects the selected unit, reducing damage received from Earth spells.

descriptions.title: Advanced Protection from Earth
descriptions.text: Protects the selected unit, reducing damage received from Earth spells.  Protection is  nearly twice that of Basic Protection from Earth.

descriptions.title: Expert Protection from Earth
descriptions.text: Protects the selected unit, reducing damage received from Earth spells.  Protection is  nearly twice that of Basic Protection from Earth.

descriptions.title: Anti-magic
descriptions.text: Protects the selected unit from all low level spells.

descriptions.title: Basic Anti-magic
descriptions.text: Protects the selected unit from all low level spells.

descriptions.title: Advanced Anti-magic
descriptions.text: Protects the selected unit all but the most powerful spells.

descriptions.title: Expert Anti-magic
descriptions.text: Protects the selected unit from all spells.

descriptions.title: Dispel
descriptions.text: Removes all spell effects from a friendly creature.

descriptions.title: Basic Dispel
descriptions.text: Removes all spell effects from a friendly creature.

descriptions.title: Advanced Dispel
descriptions.text: Removes all spell effects from a friendly or hostile creature.

descriptions.title: Expert Dispel
descriptions.text: Removes all spell effects from all units on the battlefield.

descriptions.title: Magic Mirror
descriptions.text: Reflects hostile spells towards a random enemy creature 20% of the time.

descriptions.title: Basic Magic Mirror
descriptions.text: Reflects hostile spells towards a random enemy creature 20% of the time.

descriptions.title: Advanced Magic Mirror
descriptions.text: Reflects hostile spells towards a random enemy creature 30% of the time.

descriptions.title: Expert Magic Mirror
descriptions.text: Reflects hostile spells towards a random enemy creature 40% of the time.

descriptions.title: Cure
descriptions.text: Removes all negative spell effects and heals a small number of hit points on the selected unit.

descriptions.title: Basic Cure
descriptions.text: Removes all negative spell effects and heals a small number of hit points on the selected unit.

descriptions.title: Advanced Cure
descriptions.text: Removes all negative spell effects and heals a small number of hit points on all friendly units.  Damage healed is 10 points more than Basic Cure.

descriptions.title: Expert Cure
descriptions.text: Removes all negative spell effects and heals a small number of hit points on all friendly units.  Damage healed is 20 points more than Basic Cure.

descriptions.title: Resurrection
descriptions.text: Resurrects units in the selected group by restoring a fixed number of hit points to the target.

descriptions.title: Basic Resurrection
descriptions.text: Resurrects units in the selected group by restoring a fixed number of hit points to the target.

descriptions.title: Advanced Resurrection
descriptions.text: Resurrects units in the selected group by restoring a fixed number of hit points to the target.  Provides an additional 40 hit points over Basic Resurrection.

descriptions.title: Expert Resurrection
descriptions.text: Resurrects units in the selected group by restoring a fixed number of hit points to the target.   Provides an additional 120 hit points over Basic Resurrection.

descriptions.title: Animate Dead
descriptions.text: Re-animates any destroyed undead in the selected group by restoring a fixed number of hit points to the target.

descriptions.title: Basic Animate Dead
descriptions.text: Re-animates any destroyed undead in the selected group by restoring a fixed number of hit points to the target.

descriptions.title: Advanced Animate Dead
descriptions.text: Re-animates any destroyed undead in the selected group by restoring a fixed number of hit points to the target.  Provides an additional 30 hit points over Basic Animate Dead.

descriptions.title: Expert Animate Dead
descriptions.text: Re-animates any destroyed undead in the selected group by restoring a fixed number of hit points to the target.  Provides an additional 130  hit points over Basic Animate Dead.

descriptions.title: Sacrifice
descriptions.text: Destroys a friendly creature group in order to resurrect a dead group.  Number of resurrected creatures depends on the caster's spell power and the health of the destroyed stack.

descriptions.title: Basic Sacrifice
descriptions.text: Destroys a friendly creature group in order to resurrect a dead group.  Number of resurrected creatures depends on the caster's spell power and the health of the destroyed stack.

descriptions.title: Advanced Sacrifice
descriptions.text: Destroys a friendly creature group in order to resurrect a dead group.  Number of resurrected creatures depends on the caster's spell power and the health of the destroyed stack.  Restores more creature health than Basic Sacrifice.

descriptions.title: Expert Sacrifice
descriptions.text: Destroys a friendly creature group in order to resurrect a dead group.  Number of resurrected creatures depends on the caster's spell power and the health of the destroyed stack.  Restores more creature health than Advanced Sacrifice.

descriptions.title: Bless
descriptions.text: Causes the selected unit to inflict maximum damage in combat.

descriptions.title: Basic Bless
descriptions.text: Causes the selected unit to inflict maximum damage in combat.

descriptions.title: Advanced Bless
descriptions.text: Causes the selected unit to inflict greater than their normal maximum damage in combat.

descriptions.title: Expert Bless
descriptions.text: Causes all friendly units to inflict greater than their normal maximum damage in combat.

descriptions.title: Curse
descriptions.text: Causes the selected enemy unit to inflict minimum damage in combat.

descriptions.title: Basic Curse
descriptions.text: Causes the selected enemy unit to inflict minimum damage in combat.

descriptions.title: Advanced Curse
descriptions.text: Causes the selected enemy unit to inflict less than their normal minimum damage in combat.

descriptions.title: Expert Curse
descriptions.text: Causes all enemy units to inflict less than their normal minimum damage in combat.

descriptions.title: Bloodlust
descriptions.text: Increases the hand-to-hand damage inflicted by the selected unit.

descriptions.title: Basic Bloodlust
descriptions.text: Increases the hand-to-hand damage inflicted by the selected unit.

descriptions.title: Advanced Bloodlust
descriptions.text: Increases the hand-to-hand damage inflicted by the selected unit.  Effect is twice that of Basic Bloodlust.

descriptions.title: Expert Bloodlust
descriptions.text: Increases the hand-to-hand damage inflicted by all friendly units.  Effect is twice that of Basic Bloodlust.

descriptions.title: Precision
descriptions.text: Increases the ranged attack damage inflicted by the selected unit.

descriptions.title: Basic Precision
descriptions.text: Increases the ranged attack damage inflicted by the selected unit.

descriptions.title: Advanced Precision
descriptions.text: Increases the ranged attack damage inflicted by the selected unit.  Effect is twice that of Basic Precision.

descriptions.title: Expert Precision
descriptions.text: Increases the ranged attack damage inflicted by all friendly units.  Effect is twice that of Basic Precision.

descriptions.title: Weakness
descriptions.text: Reduces the selected enemy unit's attack strength.

descriptions.title: Basic Weakness
descriptions.text: Reduces the selected enemy unit's attack strength.

descriptions.title: Advanced Weakness
descriptions.text: Reduces the selected enemy unit's attack strength.  Effect is twice that of Basic Weakness.

descriptions.title: Expert Weakness
descriptions.text: Reduces the attack strength of all enemy units.  Effect is twice that of Basic Weakness.

descriptions.title: Stone Skin
descriptions.text: Increases the selected unit's defense strength.

descriptions.title: Basic Stone Skin
descriptions.text: Increases the selected unit's defense strength.

descriptions.title: Advanced Stone Skin
descriptions.text: Increases the selected unit's defense strength.  Effect is twice that of Basic Stone Skin.

descriptions.title: Expert Stone Skin
descriptions.text: Increases the defense strength of all friendly units.  Effect is twice that of Basic Stone Skin.

descriptions.title: Disrupting Ray
descriptions.text: Reduces the selected enemy unit's defense strength.  A single enemy may be targeted multiple times by this spell.

descriptions.title: Basic Disrupting Ray
descriptions.text: Reduces the selected enemy unit's defense strength.  A single enemy may be targeted multiple times by this spell.

descriptions.title: Advanced Disrupting Ray
descriptions.text: Reduces the selected enemy unit's defense strength.  A single enemy may be targeted multiple times by this spell.  Effect is greater than that of Basic Disrupting Ray.

descriptions.title: Expert Disrupting Ray
descriptions.text: Reduces the selected enemy unit's defense strength.  A single enemy may be targeted multiple times by this spell.  Effect is greater than that of Advanced Disrupting Ray.

descriptions.title: Prayer
descriptions.text: Bestows a bonus to the attack strength, defense strength and speed of the selected unit.

descriptions.title: Basic Prayer
descriptions.text: Bestows a bonus to the attack strength, defense strength and speed of the selected unit.

descriptions.title: Advanced Prayer
descriptions.text: Bestows a bonus to the attack strength, defense strength and speed of the selected unit.  Effect is twice that of Basic Prayer.

descriptions.title: Expert Prayer
descriptions.text: Bestows a bonus to the attack strength, defense strength and speed of all friendly units.  Effect is twice that of Basic Prayer.

descriptions.title: Mirth
descriptions.text: Increases the selected unit's morale.

descriptions.title: Basic Mirth
descriptions.text: Increases the selected unit's morale.

descriptions.title: Advanced Mirth
descriptions.text: Increases the selected unit's morale.  Effect is twice that of Basic Mirth.

descriptions.title: Expert Mirth
descriptions.text: Increases the morale of all friendly units.  Effect is twice that of Basic Mirth.

descriptions.title: Sorrow
descriptions.text: Reduces the morale of the selected enemy unit.

descriptions.title: Basic Sorrow
descriptions.text: Reduces the morale of the selected enemy unit.

descriptions.title: Advanced Sorrow
descriptions.text: Reduces the morale of the selected enemy unit.  Effect is twice that of Basic Sorrow.

descriptions.title: Expert Sorrow
descriptions.text: Reduces the morale of all enemy units.  Effect is twice that of Basic Sorrow.

descriptions.title: Fortune
descriptions.text: Increases the selected unit's luck.

descriptions.title: Basic Fortune
descriptions.text: Increases the selected unit's luck.

descriptions.title: Advanced Fortune
descriptions.text: Increases the selected unit's luck.  Effect is twice that of Basic Fortune.

descriptions.title: Expert Fortune
descriptions.text: Increases the luck of all friendly units.  Effect is twice that of Basic Fortune.

descriptions.title: Misfortune
descriptions.text: Reduces the luck of the selected enemy unit.

descriptions.title: Basic Misfortune
descriptions.text: Reduces the luck of the selected enemy unit.  Spell Point cost is half that of Normal Misfortune.

descriptions.title: Advanced Misfortune
descriptions.text: Reduces the luck of the selected enemy unit.  Effect is twice that of Basic Misfortune.

descriptions.title: Expert Misfortune
descriptions.text: Reduces the luck of all enemy units.  Effect is twice that of Basic Misfortune.

descriptions.title: Haste
descriptions.text: Increases the speed of the selected unit.

descriptions.title: Basic Haste
descriptions.text: Increases the speed of the selected unit.

descriptions.title: Advanced Haste
descriptions.text: Increases the speed of the selected unit.  Effect is nearly twice that of Basic Haste.

descriptions.title: Expert Haste
descriptions.text: Increases the speed of all friendly units.  Effect is nearly twice that of Basic Haste.

descriptions.title: Slow
descriptions.text: Reduces the speed of the selected enemy unit.

descriptions.title: Basic Slow
descriptions.text: Reduces the speed of the selected enemy unit.

descriptions.title: Advanced Slow
descriptions.text: Reduces the speed of the selected enemy unit.  Effect is twice that of Basic Slow.

descriptions.title: Expert Slow
descriptions.text: Reduces the speed of all enemy units.  Effect is twice that of Basic Slow.

descriptions.title: Slayer
descriptions.text: Increases the amount of damage inflicted by a unit when fighting against Dragons, Behemoths and Hydras.

descriptions.title: Basic Slayer
descriptions.text: Increases the amount of damage inflicted by a unit when fighting against Dragons, Behemoths and Hydras.

descriptions.title: Advanced Slayer
descriptions.text: Increases the amount of damage inflicted by a unit when fighting against Dragons, Behemoths, Hydras, Devils and Angels.

descriptions.title: Expert Slayer
descriptions.text: Increases the amount of damage inflicted by a unit when fighting against Dragons, Behemoths, Hydras, Devils, Angels and Titans.

descriptions.title: Frenzy
descriptions.text: Selected troop intentionally lowers its defenses to increase the ferocity of its attack.

descriptions.title: Basic Frenzy
descriptions.text: Selected troop intentionally lowers its defenses to increase the ferocity of its attack.

descriptions.title: Advanced Frenzy
descriptions.text: Selected troop intentionally lowers its defenses to increase the ferocity of its attack.  Bonus to attack is 50% greater than Basic Frenzy.

descriptions.title: Expert Frenzy
descriptions.text: Selected troop intentionally lowers its defenses to increase the ferocity of its attack.  Bonus to attack is double Basic Frenzy.

descriptions.title: Titan's Lightning Bolt
descriptions.text: Does 600 points of damage at no spell cost to the spellcaster.

descriptions.title: Titan's Lightning Bolt
descriptions.text: Does 600 points of damage at no spell cost to the spellcaster.

descriptions.title: Titan's Lightning Bolt
descriptions.text: Does 600 points of damage at no spell cost to the spellcaster.

descriptions.title: Titan's Lightning Bolt
descriptions.text: Does 600 points of damage at no spell cost to the spellcaster.

descriptions.title: Counterstrike
descriptions.text: The selected unit will retaliate against one additional attack each round.

descriptions.title: Basic Counterstrike
descriptions.text: The selected unit will retaliate against one additional attack each round.

descriptions.title: Advanced Counterstrike
descriptions.text: The selected unit will retaliate against two additional attacks each round.

descriptions.title: Expert Counterstrike
descriptions.text: All friendly units will retaliate against two additional attacks each round.

descriptions.title: Berserk
descriptions.text: The targeted unit will randomly attack the nearest unit, be it friend or foe.

descriptions.title: Basic Berserk
descriptions.text: The targeted unit will randomly attack the nearest unit, be it friend or foe.

descriptions.title: Advanced Berserk
descriptions.text: The targeted unit will randomly attack the nearest unit, be it friend or foe.  Area of effect is six hexes greater than Basic Berserk.

descriptions.title: Expert Berserk
descriptions.text: The targeted unit will randomly attack the nearest unit, be it friend or foe.  Area of effect is eighteen hexes greater than Basic Berserk.

descriptions.title: Hypnotize
descriptions.text: Puts an enemy unit temporarily under your control.

descriptions.title: Basic Hypnotize
descriptions.text: Puts an enemy unit temporarily under your control.

descriptions.title: Advanced Hypnotize
descriptions.text: Puts an enemy unit temporarily under your control.  Allows you to control an additional 10 hit points of enemies over Basic Hypnotize.

descriptions.title: Expert Hypnotize
descriptions.text: Puts an enemy unit temporarily under your control.  Allows you to control an additional 40 hit points of enemies over Basic Hypnotize.

descriptions.title: Forgetfulness
descriptions.text: Half of the selected enemy unit forgets to use its ranged attack.

descriptions.title: Basic Forgetfulness
descriptions.text: Half of the selected enemy unit forgets to use its ranged attack.

descriptions.title: Advanced Forgetfulness
descriptions.text: Causes the selected enemy unit to forget to use its ranged attack in combat.

descriptions.title: Expert Forgetfulness
descriptions.text: Causes all enemy troops to forget to use their ranged attack in combat.

descriptions.title: Blind
descriptions.text: Blinds a creature so that it cannot move and causes it to counterattack at half its normal attack strength.  Blindness persists until the unit is attacked or dispelled.

descriptions.title: Basic Blind
descriptions.text: Blinds a creature so that it cannot move and causes it to counterattack at half its normal attack strength.  Blindness persists until the unit is attacked or dispelled.

descriptions.title: Advanced Blind
descriptions.text: Blinds a creature so that it cannot move and causes it to counterattack at one-quarter of its normal attack strength.  Blindness persists until the unit is attacked or dispelled.

descriptions.title: Expert Blind
descriptions.text: Blinds a creature so that it cannot move or counterattack.  Blindness persists until the unit is attacked or dispelled.

descriptions.title: Teleport
descriptions.text: Teleports any friendly unit to any unoccupied spot on the battlefield.

descriptions.title: Basic Teleport
descriptions.text: Teleports any friendly unit to an unoccupied spot on the battlefield.  Troop cannot teleport over walls or moats.

descriptions.title: Advanced Teleport
descriptions.text: Teleports any friendly unit to an unoccupied spot on the battlefield.  Troop cannot teleport over walls.

descriptions.title: Expert Teleport
descriptions.text: Teleports any friendly unit to any unoccupied spot on the battlefield.

descriptions.title: Remove Obstacle
descriptions.text: Removes any normal obstacle (trees, rocks, etc.) of the caster's choice from the battlefield.

descriptions.title: Basic Remove Obstacle
descriptions.text: Removes any normal obstacle (trees, rocks, etc.) of the caster's choice from the battlefield.

descriptions.title: Advanced Remove Obstacle
descriptions.text: Removes any normal obstacle (trees, rocks, etc.) or Fire Wall of the caster's choice from the battlefield.

descriptions.title: Expert Remove Obstacle
descriptions.text: Removes any normal or magical obstacle of the caster's choice from the battlefield.

descriptions.title: Clone
descriptions.text: Creates a duplicate of the selected unit stack.  The image is dispelled if it is attacked.  Clones creatures of levels 1-5.

descriptions.title: Basic Clone
descriptions.text: Creates a duplicate of the selected unit stack.  The image is dispelled if it is attacked.  Clones creatures of levels 1-5.

descriptions.title: Advanced Clone
descriptions.text: Creates a duplicate of the selected unit stack.  The image is dispelled if it is attacked.  Clones creatures of levels 1-6.

descriptions.title: Expert Clone
descriptions.text: Creates a duplicate of the selected unit stack.  The image is dispelled if it is attacked.  Clones creatures of any level.

descriptions.title: Summon Fire Elemental
descriptions.text: Allows you to summon fire elementals.  Once cast, no other elemental types may be summoned.

descriptions.title: Basic Summon Fire Elemental
descriptions.text: Allows you to summon fire elementals.  Once cast, no other elemental types may be summoned.

descriptions.title: Advanced Summon Fire Elemental
descriptions.text: Allows you to summon fire elementals.  Once cast, no other elemental types may be summoned.  Summons approximately one-and-a-half times the number of units as Basic Summon Fire Elemental.

descriptions.title: Expert Summon Fire Elemental
descriptions.text: Allows you to summon fire elementals.  Once cast, no other elemental types may be summoned.  Summons approximately twice the number of units as Basic Summon Fire Elemental.

descriptions.title: Summon Earth Elemental
descriptions.text: Allows you to summon earth elementals.  Once cast, no other elemental types may be summoned.

descriptions.title: Basic Summon Earth Elemental
descriptions.text: Allows you to summon earth elementals.  Once cast, no other elemental types may be summoned.

descriptions.title: Advanced Summon Earth Elemental
descriptions.text: Allows you to summon earth elementals.  Once cast, no other elemental types may be summoned.  Summons approximately one-and-a-half times the number of units as Basic Summon Creature.

descriptions.title: Expert Summon Earth Elemental
descriptions.text: Allows you to summon earth elementals.  Once cast, no other elemental types may be summoned.  Summons approximately twice the number of units as Basic Summon Creature.

descriptions.text: Allows you to summon water elementals.  Once cast, no other elemental types may be summoned.

descriptions.title: Advanced Summon Water Elemental
descriptions.text: Allows you to summon water elementals.  Once cast, no other elemental types may be summoned.  Summons approximately one-and-a-half times the number of units as Basic Summon Water Elemental.

descriptions.title: Expert Summon Water Elemental
descriptions.text: Allows you to summon water elementals.  Once cast, no other elemental types may be summoned.  Summons approximately twice the number of units as Basic Summon Water Elemental.

descriptions.text: Allows you to summon air elementals.  Once cast, no other elemental types may be summoned.

descriptions.title: Basic Summon Air Elemental
descriptions.text: Allows you to summon air elementals.  Once cast, no other elemental types may be summoned.

descriptions.title: Advanced Summon Air Elemental
descriptions.text: Allows you to summon air elementals.  Once cast, no other elemental types may be summoned.  Summons approximately one-and-a-half times the number of units as Basic Summon Air Elemental.

descriptions.text: Allows you to summon air elementals.  Once cast, no other elemental types may be summoned.  Summons approximately twice the number of units as Basic Summon Air Elemental.
